verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair axis for a docs platform, but the pack documents no first-party bulk-edit or batch-action capability across many pages or items. The closest items don't qualify: the MCP server lets agents restructure docs, Git Sync allows editing files in Git, the REST API is a building block, and auto translations is a different feature. None of these is a documented bulk-operations capability, so the axis applies and the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
